story: IBM, sonic delay lines, and the history of the 80×24 display
text: And the reason they were modeled after the dollar bill size is because there were already many types of systems for storing and organizing them. That came in handy for the census. The old BBC Connections series has a segment with James Burke using the old census tabulators. [VIDEO]
